messages:
maria (Finance): spotted some NetSuite invoices that appear duplicated — nightly reconcile flagged them as orphans (no external id).

devin (Revenue Ops): any idea where they came from? support tickets starting to trickle in.

arun (Eng): quick check of webhook logs shows a spike of accepted POSTs to /webhooks/stripe with missing signature header between 2025-11-03T02:05Z and 2025-11-03T03:10Z. handler returned 200 for those requests due to a hotfix that suppressed errors.

laura (SRE): ops-bot: scale down cron/billing-backfill for now.
ops-bot: cronjob billing-backfill scaled to 0 (requested by laura).

arun (Eng): examples: stripe_inv_01L4aaAA, stripe_inv_01L4bbBB. payloads lacked idempotency_key and external_source_id so backfill created new NS records.

maria (Finance): how many? rough count from the nightly job is 29 duplicates across 9 customers. amounts small but manual work is annoying.

devin (Revenue Ops): plan? auto-void small ones, escalate enterprise to AR.

arun (Eng): immediate fixes: 1) revert shim behavior to 401 on missing/invalid signature (PR ready), 2) pause backfill (done), 3) run detection query and tag affected NS records as temp_orphan so backfill won't re-ingest.

laura (SRE): detection query complete: 31 NS invoices with null external_source_id in the window. tagging now.

maria (Finance): we'll auto-credit invoices < $250. i'll produce enterprise list for manual review.

arun (Eng): patched and rolled shim at 03:45 UTC. will replay official Stripe events for the affected invoices after AR sign-off. added Sentry alert for "missing_external_source_id".

devin (Revenue Ops): updating runbook: include secret rotation checklist and add a gating step to confirm webhook shim returns 401 before rotating.

maria (Finance): thanks team. monitoring showed no new duplicates after the patch. closing once AR resolves enterprise credits. :thumbsup:
